profile.headline: Solve complex problem of existing systems in a simplest manner | Freelance Full Stack Developer at Upwork
profile.summary:
●Perspicacious web developer having 5+ years of experience in website and web application development which supports all browsers and various platforms.
●Experience with analysis, design, testing, and implementing Web-based applications, client-server applications, N- tier applications, and Windows Services-based applications.
●Excels in PHP Language and its frameworks like Laravel, database management in SQL(Structured Query Language), Jquery, and Ajax.
●Develop applications using fundamentals of Object-Oriented Programming. 
●One year of experience working with Javascript frameworks like ReactJS, NodeJS, and Java also. 
●Working with dedication and fulfilling requirements within a time period is my motto.
●Ability to meet deadlines, and adaptability to ever-changing priorities.
●Creative problem solver with a strong technical skill set.
●Learning new things and expanding my knowledge are very important to me.
●Experience in Directing team meetings to check on progress and plan code direction and ability to read code and suggest changes to make the finished project glitch-free.
●Proactively look for key areas of improvement in the project and put suggestions forward for review.

positions.description:
Environment: Php (Laravel framework), Mysql, HTML5, Ajax, Jquery, Css3, etc
Responsibilities:
●Implementing a high variability data ingestion system.
●Built highly scalable background services to convert a variety of excel documents to a unified XML format.
●Developed SQL jobs to bulk ingest the unified XML document into an RDBMS.
●Implementing features like add to cart, wishlist, discount & offers, ratings, and reviews that encourage and help customers to buy the most appropriate items. We also offer order cancellation, return, and shipping services.
●Supports online payment options such as Card, Google Pay, and Paytm.
●Implementing Excel and Pdf export capabilities using packages.
●Gathering and addressing technical and design requirements, developing a system, testing, and debugging are the key responsibilities.

positions.title: PHP Web Developer
positions.description:
Environment: Php (Laravel framework with onion architecture), Mysql, AngularJS, etc.
Responsibilities:
●Developed a system for multiple companies to manage their inventories and accounting reports. 
●Accounting management systems include sales, purchases, orders, payments, receipts, quotations, and job forms. According to local law, a report builder and different accounting statements are also included. 
●Working on back-end programming including scanning products, generating bills, and log maintenance.
●To build the latest technology system, a number of Laravel composer packages are used, including Samuelterra22, the php-barcode-generator package, TCPDF, CKEditor, the maatwebsite package, and mailgun. Used various Artisan commands through the command line interface.
●Work with different Join, primary-key, and foreign key concepts used while developing a database. SQL Trigger is also used to perform the special operation while special events occur in a database.
●Worked on Amazon Rest API to get and display amazon seller data.undamentals of Object-Oriented Programming
●Managing projects, delivering them on time, working with a team, following standard programming rules, writing error-free code, debugging, and testing, along with learning new features and implementing them are the major roles in this company.
